title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in Mambasa, Irumu and Djugu territories in Irumi Province, DRC works towards the goal that people in crisis can transition from assistance to become resilient. This objective focuses on ensuring people affected are able to protect, revitalise and restore their livelihoods. Activities focus on access to agricultural inputs, training, wetland and permaculture, seed multiplication and preservation of native seeds and access to village saving and loans associations. The principal focus of this objective is: - Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practices - Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population - reduce poverty at a household level for the most marginalised of a community - Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys - Building resilience to climate change involves applying strategies that are directly related to climate adaptation - agroecology, protecting natural resources and poverty reduction are part of this as they support individuals, households and communities to adapt to climate change impacts so they are better able to cope.
